searchText: <@550420431744794624> I never replied to you on ACD but yes, I agree with you that we should anchor on 21K and decide gas pricing according to that. Yeah, I think that’s the right approach here, I’ll run the numbers based off of that. That definitely precludes external rebasing, and we’ll have to see how big the rounding error is and whether it justifies particle-gas/internal rebasing If we really want to disrupt as little as possible, then we’ll probably have to make our reference point a linear interpolation between the 21k tx cost and the 2.3k contract sub-call cost.
